about: Golden questions for MonsterGPT v2 (docs/architecture/monster-gpt-v2.md section 11). Expected facts come from `truth` SQL run read-only at test time, never typed by hand. Checks: tools (each listed tool must be called), facts (each listed {template} filled from the truth row must appear in the answer, any alias accepted), forbid (regexes that must not match), abstain (the answer must say it could not verify and contain no number outside the question). Phase 2 skeleton: 2 questions per workflow; Phase 8 grows it to about 70.

questions.text: Who won the most recent NBA championship?
questions.truth: SELECT CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN home_team ELSE away_team END FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND game_type='POST' AND home_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN home_team ELSE away_team END FROM sports_games WHERE sport='mlb' AND game_type='POST' AND season=2025 AND home_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: What are the latest NBA standings? Who has the best record?
questions.truth: WITH g AS (SELECT home_team t, (home_score > away_score)::int w FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND game_type='REG' AND season=(SELECT max(season) FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND game_type='REG' AND home_score IS NOT NULL) AND home_score IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT away_team, (away_score > home_score)::int FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND game_type='REG' AND season=(SELECT max(season) FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND game_type='REG' AND home_score IS NOT NULL) AND home_score IS NOT NULL) SELECT t, sum(w)::int, (count(*) - sum(w))::int FROM g GROUP BY t ORDER BY sum(w)::float / count(*) DESC, sum(w) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: Show me the current NHL standings.
questions.truth: WITH g AS (SELECT home t, CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN 2 WHEN last_period IN ('OT','SO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END p FROM nhl_games_api WHERE game_type=2 AND completed AND season=(SELECT max(season) FROM nhl_games_api WHERE game_type=2 AND completed) UNION ALL SELECT away, CASE WHEN away_score > home_score THEN 2 WHEN last_period IN ('OT','SO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM nhl_games_api WHERE game_type=2 AND completed AND season=(SELECT max(season) FROM nhl_games_api WHERE game_type=2 AND completed)) SELECT t, sum(p)::int FROM g GROUP BY t ORDER BY sum(p) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: Compare Nikola Jokic and Luka Doncic in points over their last 20 games.
questions.truth: SELECT (SELECT round(avg((stats->>'pts')::numeric), 1) FROM (SELECT stats FROM player_game_logs WHERE sport='nba' AND player_id='3112335' ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 20) x), (SELECT round(avg((stats->>'pts')::numeric), 1) FROM (SELECT stats FROM player_game_logs WHERE sport='nba' AND player_id='3945274' ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 20) y)

questions.text: How many points per game has Connor McDavid averaged over his last 10 games compared with Nathan MacKinnon?
questions.truth: SELECT (SELECT round(avg((stats->>'points')::numeric), 2) FROM (SELECT stats FROM player_game_logs WHERE sport='nhl' AND player_id='8478402' ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 10) x), (SELECT round(avg((stats->>'points')::numeric), 2) FROM (SELECT stats FROM player_game_logs WHERE sport='nhl' AND player_id='8477492' ORDER BY game_date DESC LIMIT 10) y)

SELECT CASE WHEN home_team='LAL' THEN away_team ELSE home_team END FROM sports_games WHERE sport='nba' AND 'LAL' IN (home_team, away_team) AND home_score IS NULL AND game_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date ORDER BY game_date LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN home='EDM' THEN away ELSE home END FROM nhl_games_api WHERE 'EDM' IN (home, away) AND NOT completed AND start_time > now() - interval '4 hours' ORDER BY start_time LIMIT 1
